data.content:
Enapter
Enapter is the organization associated with the patented AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 and provides the Enapter website for product information.<SEP>Enapter is the organization that developed the patented anion exchange membrane electrolyser EL 4.0 and its EMS.

AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0
AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 is Enapter's patented anion exchange membrane (AEM) electrolyser, a standardised, stackable and flexible system to produce on-site hydrogen; it has a modular design with advanced software integration that allows set up in minutes and remote control and management.

Anion Exchange Membrane (AEM)
Anion exchange membrane (AEM) is the patented membrane technology used in Enapter's electrolyser for hydrogen production.

Hydrogen
Hydrogen is the substance produced on-site by the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.<SEP>Hydrogen is produced by the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0, with output purity specified at 35 barg and 8 barg.

On-Site Hydrogen Production
On-site hydrogen production is the process performed by the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 to generate hydrogen at the point of use.

Hydrogen Flowrate
Hydrogen flowrate is the required production rate that can be achieved by stacking AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 units; no numeric value is specified in the source.

Standby Condition
Standby condition refers to the condition in which no hydrogen is being produced and the auxiliary components are not powered.

Auxiliary Components
Auxiliary components are electrolyser components that are not powered during standby.

Advanced Software Integration
Advanced software integration allows set up in minutes and remote control and management of the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

Remote Control And Management
Remote control and management is a capability of the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 enabled by advanced software integration.

Battery Limits
Battery limits are a referenced source that should be checked together with the Owner's Manual for the complete requirements list.

Owner's Manual
Owner's Manual is a referenced document that should be checked for the complete requirements list for the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU
Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU is the European directive according to which the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 belongs to the S.E.P. category.

S.E.P. Category
S.E.P. category is the pressure equipment safety classification to which the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 belongs according to Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU and Pressure Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.

Pressure Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016
Pressure Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 is the UK regulation according to which the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 belongs to the S.E.P. category.

ETL
ETL is the organization associated with recognition of electrolyser versions.

ETL Recognized Electrolyser Versions
ETL recognized electrolyser versions are the only electrolyser versions recognized under the ETL notation.

Enapter Website
Enapter website at www.enapter.com/aem-electrolyser is the location for the most recent specifications of the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Hydrogen Flowrate
The required hydrogen flowrate of the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 is achieved by stacking the electrolyser; no numeric value is specified in the source.

AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Standby Condition
Standby refers to the condition of the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 in which no hydrogen is being produced and the auxiliary components are not powered.

AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Setup Time
The AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 allows set up in minutes, enabled by its modular design paired with advanced software integration; no numeric value is specified in the source.

Complete Requirements List
The complete requirements list is the set of requirements to be checked in the Battery limits and the Owner's Manual for the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 Specifications Table (table)
data.content: Two-column specification table for Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0. Lists production up to 500 NL/h (1.0785 kg/24h), purity at 35/8 barg, up to 35 barg output, 4.8 kWh/Nm³, 2.4 kW operation, 3 kW peak, water and ambient requirements, dimensions, weight, controls, and CE/UKCA/CSA conformity. It supports the surrounding text by detailing the modular, stackable, remotely managed electrolyser’s performance, utilities, and compliance for on-site hydrogen production.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Production Rate
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Production Rate
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a production rate of up to 500 NL/h, up to 1.0785 kg/24 h.

Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 is Enapter’s patented anion exchange membrane electrolyser, described as standardised, stackable, flexible, modular, software-integrated, and able to produce on-site hydrogen; the table details its technical basis for stacking units to achieve a required hydrogen flowrate.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Hydrogen Output Purity
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Hydrogen Output Purity
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a hydrogen output purity of 99.9% at 35 barg with <1,000 ppm H₂O and <5 ppm O₂ at 25 °C, and 98.8% at 8 barg with <12,000 ppm H₂O and <5 ppm O₂ at 25 °C.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Output Pressure
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Output Pressure
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has an output pressure limit of up to 35 barg.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Nominal Power Consumption per Nm³ of H₂ Produced
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Nominal Power Consumption per Nm³ of H₂ Produced
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a nominal power consumption per Nm³ of H₂ produced of 4.8 kWh/Nm³, beginning of life.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Operative Power Consumption
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Operative Power Consumption
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has an operative power consumption of 2.4 kW, beginning of life.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Peak Power Consumption
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Peak Power Consumption
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a peak power consumption of 3 kW.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Heat Dissipation
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Heat Dissipation
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a heat dissipation of 0.6 kW, beginning of life.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Max Heat Dissipation
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Max Heat Dissipation
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a max heat dissipation of 0.9 kW, end of life.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Standby Power Consumption
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Standby Power Consumption
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a standby power consumption of 0.3 kW.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Power Supply
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Power Supply
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a power supply of 220 – 240 V (AC), 50/60 Hz.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Maximum Water Input Conductivity
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Maximum Water Input Conductivity
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a maximum water input conductivity specified as minimum ASTM D1193-06 Type IV or recommended Type II or Type III.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Water Consumption
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Water Consumption
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a water consumption of ~420 mL/h at 25 °C.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Water Input Pressure Range
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Water Input Pressure Range
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a water input pressure range of 1 – 4 barg.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Ambient Operative Temperature Range
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Ambient Operative Temperature Range
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has an ambient operative temperature range of 5 °C – 45 °C.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Ambient Operative Humidity Range
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Ambient Operative Humidity Range
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has an ambient operative humidity range of up to 90% humidity, non-condensing.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: IP Rating
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: IP Rating
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has an IP rating of IP 20.

Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Dimensions
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has dimensions W: 482 mm × D: 635 mm × H: 266 mm.

Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Weight
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has a weight of 42 kg.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Space Inside Cabinet
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Space Inside Cabinet
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has 6 U space inside cabinet.

data.entity_name: Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Control and Monitoring
data.content:
Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Control and Monitoring
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 is fully automatic with Enapter’s EMS via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 :: Conformity
The Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 has conformity including CE mark according to the machine directive 2006/42/CE, UKCA mark according to Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008, and CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 Hydrogen Generators Using Water Electrolysis - Industrial, Commercial, and Residential Applications.

Enapters EMS
Enapter’s EMS is the energy management system used for fully automatic control and monitoring of the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

Wi-Fi
Wi-Fi operating at 2.4 GHz is used for communication and control of the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 via Enapter’s EMS.

Bluetooth
Bluetooth is used for communication and control of the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 via Enapter’s EMS.

Modbus TCP over Ethernet
Modbus TCP over Ethernet is used for communication and control of the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 via Enapter’s EMS.

Water
Water is consumed by the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0, with consumption of ~420 mL/h at 25 °C and input pressure range of 1–4 barg.

Oxygen
Oxygen is produced by the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0, with output purity specified as <5 ppm O₂ at both 35 barg and 8 barg.

ASTM D1193-06 Type IV
ASTM D1193-06 Type IV is the minimum water input conductivity standard specified for the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

ASTM D1193-06 Type II
ASTM D1193-06 Type II is a recommended water input conductivity standard for the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

ASTM D1193-06 Type III
ASTM D1193-06 Type III is a recommended water input conductivity standard for the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

CE mark
CE mark according to the machine directive 2006/42/CE is part of the conformity of the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

Machine Directive 2006/42/CE
Machine Directive 2006/42/CE is the regulation under which the CE mark is applied for the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

UKCA mark
UKCA mark according to Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 is part of the conformity of the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008
Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 is the regulation under which the UKCA mark is applied for the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.

data.entity_name: CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 Hydrogen Generators Using Water Electrolysis - Industrial, Commercial, and Residential Applications
data.content:
CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 Hydrogen Generators Using Water Electrolysis - Industrial, Commercial, and Residential Applications
CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 is a conformity standard for hydrogen generators using water electrolysis, applicable to the Enapter AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 for industrial, commercial, and residential applications.
